- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast by 2–5% relative to sentiment peak.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >85% of 30d high) — add 3–8% buffer to prevent premature drop.
- Lagged corrections: if sentiment drops below 0.5 after a peak, reduce forecast by 1–3% per day until sentiment stabilizes.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast > 85% of 30d high, apply downward adjustment of 5–10% to align with historical mean reversion.
- Horizon-specific: 30d forecasts often overshoot early in the period — cap forecast at 80% of 30d high if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment: if sentiment > 0.8 and forecast > 82, reduce by 1–3% to avoid overreaction to short-term volatility.
